title: Filtered acyclic complexes map trivially to filtered injective complexes
statement: Let C be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian]. Use the finite filtered homotopy categories and optional interval B of [def-trf-finite-filtered-localization]. Let A and I be bounded-below complexes in that filtered homotopy category. Assume every graded complex gr^p A is acyclic, and every graded object gr^p I^n is injective [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Then every filtered homotopy-category morphism A → I is zero. This holds for unrestricted finite filtrations and for every prescribed interval [a,b], and does not assume enough injectives.

proof.text: For a strict exact pair u,v and a filtered map r killing u, factor the underlying r through image(v) using ShortComplex.Exact.isColimitImage. Give image(v) the quotient filtration from the source of v. The factor is filtered because image of each step factors into the corresponding target step; strictness of v identifies the image filtration under the inclusion with image(v) intersected with each target step. Use the filtered injective extension property across this strict inclusion.

For a graded-acyclic complex, apply finite filtered graded exactness to each consecutive pair of differentials. The preceding extension result solves each residual homotopy equation. Adapt Mathlib CochainComplex.isKInjective_of_injective induction: improve a degree-minus-one cochain by a single component, using the cochain differential to verify the new equation, and pass to its componentwise stable limit. Boundedness below initializes the zero cochain. This yields a homotopy to zero. Finally descend the homotopy through the quotient functor, using its fullness to represent any homotopy-category arrow.

theorem filteredAcyclic_injective_vanishing (B : Option (ℤ × ℤ))
    (A I : FiniteFilteredHomotopyPlus C B false)
    (hA : ∀ p n : ℤ, IsZero ((HomotopyCategory.homologyFunctor C (.up ℤ) n).obj
      (((filteredEvaluation C B false (some p)).mapHomotopyCategoryPlus.obj A).obj)))
    (hI : ∀ n p : ℤ, Injective ((I.obj.as.X n).obj.filtration.gradedPiece p))
    (f : A ⟶ I) : f = 0
